CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.validation_conversations: id UUID PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(); validation_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.coc_validations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; subsection_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.subsections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; document_id UUID NOT NULL (no FK); created_by UUID NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(); updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(); title TEXT NULL; status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','resolved','archived')). COMMENT: 'Stores conversations about COC validations for learning and improvement'.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.validation_messages: id UUID PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(); conversation_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.validation_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('user','assistant','system')); content TEXT NOT NULL; metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}'; created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(); created_by UUID NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL. COMMENT: 'Stores individual messages in validation conversations'.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.validation_feedback: id UUID PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(); conversation_id UUID NULL REFERENCES public.validation_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; validation_id UUID NULL REFERENCES public.coc_validations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; feedback_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (feedback_type IN ('clarification','correction','enhancement','edge_case')); title TEXT NOT NULL; description TEXT NOT NULL; original_finding TEXT NULL; suggested_improvement TEXT NULL; status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','reviewed','implemented','rejected')); reviewed_by UUID NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; reviewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL; implementation_notes TEXT NULL; created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(); created_by UUID NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL. COMMENT: 'Stores curated feedback from conversations for improving the validation AI'.
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_validation_conversations_validation ON public.validation_conversations(validation_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_validation_conversations_subsection ON public.validation_conversations(subsection_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_validation_messages_conversation ON public.validation_messages(conversation_id);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_client_id() RETURNS UUID LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public. Body: SELECT client_id FROM public.user_clients WHERE user_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1; — returns the client_id mapped to the currently authenticated user; used by Client-role RLS policies to avoid recursive RLS. COMMENT: 'Returns the client_id for the currently authenticated user'.

UPDATE inspection_templates SET sections = sections || jsonb_build_object('tenantInformation', ...) WHERE name = 'Electrical Main Board (EMB) Inspection' AND category = 'Low Voltage'. Appends a 'Tenant Information' section (order_index 5) with items: tenantName (text, required), tenantContact (text), tenantPhone (text), tenantEmail (text), occupancyType (select: Retail/Office/Industrial/Restaurant/Medical/Other), leaseStartDate (date), leaseEndDate (date), tenantNotes (textarea). Mutates the live EMB template definition in place.
